pages.text: $(bold)Mercury: The Burning World$()$(br)Mobs: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:mercury difficulty}}$() the vanilla strength, like every Tier 4 world$(br)Death penalty: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:mercury death}}$()$(br2)Mercury is hot at every hour: without a full Netherite Space Suit, a Jet Suit or Fire Resistance, the planet burns you day and night. By day the sun also sets you on fire, by night the cold hurts.

$(bold)Day and Night$()$(br)$(bold)Day:$() the sun sets you on fire every 5 seconds unless your armor carries 3 levels of Stellar Shield. Each level takes a third of fire damage off; Heatward takes off another 8% a level.$(br2)$(bold)Night:$() 1.5 HP of cold damage every 5 seconds, cut by Thermal Regulation as on Mars.$(br2)Carry $(italic)both$() enchantments. Mercury's mobs have Fire Resistance.

$(bold)Purpose$()$(br)Mercury has high-value heat-resistant ores and metals found only here, and they go into building the Tier 4 Rocket.$(br2)$(bold)Structures$()$(br)Ancient solar collection arrays and heat-sealed structures dot the surface, holding rare loot you can only get on Mercury.

$(bold)Planetary Rock Extraction$()$(br)Crush $(bold)Mercury Stone$() in Create Crushing Wheels or a Thermal Pulverizer to extract:$(br)• $(bold)Solar Crystal$() (20%): crystallized solar energy$(br)• $(bold)Rare Earth Dust$() (20%): high-tech crafting$(br)• Gold Nuggets (35%)$(br2)The Thermal Pulverizer gives slightly better odds.

$(bold)Stellar Shield Enchantment$()$(br)Chests on Mercury hold books of $(bold)Stellar Shield$(): level I in 30% of them, level II in 10% (max level 3).$(br2)On armor it takes a third of fire damage off per level on every planet. Levels on different pieces add up: 3 stop it, and the sun no longer sets you on fire. With Thermal Regulation, it covers all of Mercury.$(br2)$(bold)Next: Venus.$()
